LanguageData.LP_ManaLake.label: Mana Lake
LanguageData.LP_ManaLake.description:
Here the Weave seeps out of the ground and pools into a softly glowing lake. Living by the lake is a group of spell artisans who follow no school and only "sift the lake": they press the spell fragments that crystallize in the lake water into crystals and sell them to anyone who can pay; absorb one and you permanently learn the arcanum inside.

The lakefolk themselves aren't strong; they live off the lake's yield and their many clients, and rarely start wars. Thay's Red Wizards have always wanted to seize the lake, and the witch-hunting zealots treat everyone who sells spells as witches; these two are the lakefolk's sworn enemies.

The most precious class crystals are sold only to allies.
LanguageData.LP_ManaLake.deityPresets.0.nameType.name: Mystra
LanguageData.LP_ManaLake.ideoDescription: What the lake gives, the lake takes back. Take only what you need.
